title: Brothers Forgive! 🤗 Esau and Jacob | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Two brothers who have not seen each other for twenty years... and one of them is running fast toward the other! 🏃💨 Is he angry, or is he coming for a big hug? In this Sunday School lesson for kids, we hear the Bible story of Esau and Jacob: a stolen blessing, twenty long years apart, a scared brother who prays, and a happy hug in the desert. Then Andy learns to forgive his little brother Sammy, just like Esau forgave Jacob!

📖 Memory verse: "Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God in Christ forgave you." (Ephesians 4:32)
🎯 Lesson: Forgiveness. Being angry is like carrying a heavy backpack full of rocks. When we forgive, we put it down, and God fills our heart with peace and joy.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
